description: Source code for a Bank Reconciliation Tool in ERPNext, including functions for fetching transactions, updating, creating journal/payment entries, and matching vouchers.

classes.name: BankReconciliationTool
classes.description: Main Document class for bank reconciliation operations.

methods.name: get_bank_transactions
methods.description: Fetches bank transactions for a specified account within optional date range.

methods.name: get_account_balance
methods.description: Calculates account balance till a specified date, considering system entries and reflected amounts.

methods.name: update_bank_transaction
methods.description: Updates reference number, party type, and party for a bank transaction.

methods.name: create_journal_entry_bts
methods.description: Creates and optionally submits a journal entry based on a bank transaction.

methods.name: create_payment_entry_bts
methods.description: Creates and optionally submits a payment entry based on a bank transaction.

methods.name: reconcile_vouchers
methods.description: Reconciles vouchers with a bank transaction, updating allocations.

methods.name: get_linked_payments
methods.description: Retrieves all matching payments linked to a bank transaction.
